mapper.select: SELECT id,receipt_no,disposition FROM tc_payment_receipt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id > #{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id,intent_id,order_id,channel_id,merchant_request_no,status,submitted_at,closed_at,close_evidence_ref,version FROM tc_payment_attempt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{attempt}
SELECT id,merchant_request_no FROM tc_payment_attempt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id > #{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_payment_intent SET status='CLOSED',close_fence_at=COALESCE(close_fence_at,#{now}),version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{intent} AND active_attempt_no IS NULL AND status='READY' AND succeeded_receipt_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id,payment_no,order_id,member_id,status,expected_amount,currency,active_attempt_no,succeeded_receipt_id,close_fence_at,version FROM tc_payment_intent WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} FOR UPDATE

SELECT i.payment_no,i.order_id,i.status,i.expected_amount,i.currency,i.active_attempt_no,i.version,a.status AS attempt_status,i.business_no FROM tc_payment_intent i LEFT JOIN tc_payment_attempt a ON a.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND a.merchant_request_no=i.active_attempt_no WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND i.member_id=#{member} AND i.business_no=#{number}i.payment_no=#{number}
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_payment_intent SET active_attempt_no=#{number},status='PENDING',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{intent} AND active_attempt_no IS NULL AND close_fence_at IS NULL AND status='READY'
mapper.select: SELECT id,intent_id,order_id,channel_id,merchant_request_no,status,submitted_at,closed_at,close_evidence_ref,version FROM tc_payment_attempt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND merchant_request_no=#{number}

SELECT id,intent_id,order_id,channel_id,merchant_request_no,status,submitted_at,closed_at,close_evidence_ref,version FROM tc_payment_attempt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND merchant_request_no=#{number} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_payment_attempt SET submitted_at=#{now},status='UNKNOWN',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND merchant_request_no=#{number} AND status='PREPARED' AND submitted_at IS NULL
UPDATE tc_payment_intent SET close_fence_at=COALESCE(close_fence_at,#{now}),version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{intent} AND close_fence_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id,receipt_no,intent_id,attempt_id,order_id,provider_transaction_no,amount,currency,provider_paid_at,confirmed_at,disposition,evidence_ref FROM tc_payment_receipt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND channel_code=#{code} AND channel_merchant_no=#{channelMerchant} AND provider_transaction_no=#{transaction} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_payment_receipt(tenant_id,receipt_no,business_no,intent_id,attempt_id,order_id,channel_code,channel_merchant_no,provider_transaction_no,amount,currency,provider_paid_at,confirmed_at,disposition,evidence_ref,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{receiptNo},#{businessNo},#{intent},#{attempt},#{order},#{code},#{channelMerchant},#{transaction},#{amount},#{currency},#{providerPaid},#{now},#{disposition},#{evidence},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=tc_payment_receipt.id
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_payment_intent SET succeeded_receipt_id=#{receipt},status='SUCCEEDED',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{intent} AND succeeded_receipt_id IS NULL AND status IN ('PENDING','REVIEW')
UPDATE tc_payment_intent SET status='REVIEW',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{intent} AND status IN ('READY','PENDING')
UPDATE tc_payment_attempt SET status='SUCCEEDED',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND merchant_request_no=#{number} AND status IN ('PREPARED','UNKNOWN')

UPDATE tc_payment_attempt SET status='CLOSED',closed_at=#{now},close_evidence_ref=#{evidence},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND merchant_request_no=#{number} AND status IN ('PREPARED','UNKNOWN')

UPDATE tc_payment_intent SET active_attempt_no=NULL,status=#{status},close_fence_at=COALESCE(close_fence_at,#{fence}),version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{intent} AND active_attempt_no=#{number} AND succeeded_receipt_id IS NULL
